router_id.description: Router ID for BIRD (must be an IPv4 address, typically loopback).

gateway.description: Next-hop IPv4 address for the static route.

static_routes.description: List of static IPv4 routes to inject into BIRD.

name.description: Optional BGP protocol name (auto-generated if omitted).

remote_as.description: Remote AS number of the peer.

in_prefix_filter.description: List of IPv4 prefixes allowed for import (e.g., [0.0.0.0/0]).

out_prefix_filter.description: List of IPv4 prefixes allowed for export.

bgp_peers.description: List of BGP peer sessions to configure.

ospf_instance_name.description: Name of the OSPF instance (ignored unless enable_ospf=true).

ospf_area_id.description: OSPF area ID (numeric or dotted decimal, e.g., '0.0.0.0').

ospf_interface.description: Interface name to run OSPF on.

bgp_rr_enabled.description: Enable BGP route reflection (for RR clients).

bgp_rr_name.description: Name for the route reflector BGP protocol.

bgp_rr_local_as.description: Local AS number for the route reflector.

bgp_rr_cluster_id.description: Cluster ID for BGP route reflection (IPv4 format).
